shortDescription: Hong Kong-listed Simcere Pharmaceutical HKEX:2096 said on Friday that anti-influenza drug Xianlinda, developed by its unit and Jiaxing AnDiCon Biotech, received marketing approval from China's main drug regulator as the flu season begins.
